scene: stationary textured background; translated slatted foreground x[576,1344),y[288,792),32-pixel slats in a48-pixel period; distinct nonconstant forward device-Z and previous-current MV boundaries
guide_coordinates: output_position=(g+0.5)*O/G-0.5; raw subtracts J720*O/720; corrected evaluates the same physical scene at output_position. MV=(-translation)*G/O on foreground, zero background.
history: new feature for each branch, creation submit+10s fence, first reset1 then reset0 except reset_second reset1/1, branch final fence then public release; model/device can be reused, never feature history

oracle.mask: fixed geometry and visibility only; 64px outer border; foreground/background interior >=4px from all physical boundaries; foreground boundary band <=2px; background current AND previous visibility; no residual-selection
oracle.functional: every frame real eval1/result1/resolve1/fence, readback equals exact uploaded source/depth/mv, rawRGB finite and NaN poison replaced, outputRGBA finite/non-sentinel/alpha bit exact; five feature create/release and normal shutdown
oracle.sensitivity: primary vs zero_mv/reverse_mv/reset_second each RGB RMS difference > max(rms_floor,5*primary-repeat RGB RMS); otherwise behavior NOT_IDENTIFIED, not technical FAIL
oracle.utility: primary MSE vs clean truth <=0.98 * EACH zero/reverse/reset MSE on all, foreground interior and foreground boundary masks; also improvement beyond repeat noise RMS bound
oracle.pair_selection: same masks; lower MSE by >=2% and RMSE gap > repeat bound in all/foreground/boundary and both fixed tile parity splits, both candidates functionally valid; winning candidate additionally sensitive and useful; otherwise NOT_IDENTIFIED
oracle.non_claims: synthetic known phase only; not game k_output, NR absolute normalization, image quality, performance,120frame gate or shared transport validation
